subject: Provisioning checklist: preflight and backstop plan for NovaCare AI launch
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Provisioning checklist: preflight and backstop plan for NovaCare AI launch

Team —

NovaCare confirmed their production launch window: July 12–14 (US customers). They asked for a firm commitment on a temporary capacity uplift and an automatic backstop in case the 95th percentile token TPS exceeds our forecast during the first 72 hours. High level asks:

- Confirm provisional rate bucket increase from 10k TPS -> 30k TPS for the launch weekend
- Provide a fallback plan to degrade to a cheaper model variant without failing customer requests if sustained latencies go beyond SLA
- Document canary ramp schedule (0.5% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) and guardrails for each step

Attached: initial provisioning checklist and the traffic model NovaCare shared (v2). I need a short internal playbook we can give the CS/CTI team by EOD Friday so they can align on on-call coverage and escalation paths.

Specific asks:
- Rishi: confirm commercial guardrail (what we can safely commit without exec signoff) and the temporary billing construct (credit vs invoice).
- Marcus: are there kernel/instance profiles we should reserve? If so, what lead times and exact SKUs?
- Lauren: product questions — can the routing policy automatically downgrade to a quantized 8-bit variant for non-critical requests? Any known quality regressions?

Thanks,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning checklist: preflight and backstop plan for NovaCare AI launch

Thanks, Olga — good summary. Quick answers and open items: 

1) Commercial guardrail: we can approve a temporary uplift to 30k TPS under a 30-day invoice commitment with a usage credit applied for any overage spikes above committed baseline. Anything above 30k needs VP approval. I'll draft the wording for the customer-facing temporary amendment.

2) Billing construct: recommend a short "launch credit" line item — converts to standard usage at the end of the 30-day period. Finance okayed this approach for pilots.

Open: we need the expected 95th percentile steady state and peak burst durations to size buffer. The CSV you attached has per-minute projections but not 5-min rolling percentiles. Can we ask NovaCare to provide a 5-min 95p or allow us to compute from raw?

Marcus, ping on the SKU lead time — do we need to pre-warm instance reservations or can we rely on rapid provisioning with autoscale? Also, any constraints on model-bitwidth fallback?

Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@novacare.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@novacare.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Provisioning checklist: preflight and backstop plan for NovaCare AI launch

Jamie — forwarding our internal preflight with a couple follow-ups so we can finalize the runbook. Please see attached: nova_traffic_model_v2.csv and a provisioning checklist draft. A few quick asks so we can lock config and billing: 

- Can you provide 5-min rolling 95th percentile token TPS for your production preview (last 14 days)? If you only have per-minute, the CSV is fine but we need to compute 5-min 95p.
- Expected sustained peak window length and expected daily regional split (US/EU/APAC).
- Are there any downstream SLAs (third-party infra) that will cause backfilled bursts?

We propose the following conservative preflight: reserve a pool equivalent to 30k TPS for the first 72 hours with canary ramping 0.5%/2%/10%/50%/100% across 12 hours. If you prefer a longer ramp we can stretch to 48 hours. This is not final contract language, just an operational ask so we can reserve capacity and set fallback policies.

Attachments: provisioning_checklist.pdf (draft), nova_traffic_model_v2.csv

Thanks — please loop in anyone from your SRE/prodops who can share the 5-min percentiles.

Best,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@novacare.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@novacare.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisioning checklist: preflight and backstop plan for NovaCare AI launch

Thanks for the quick turn, Olga and Rishi. We're on it — looping in ops (we'll send raw minute-level logs so you can compute 5-min 95p if that helps). Quick clarifications: 

- 95p expected steady-state: ~18k token TPS (5-min 95p) with predicted short bursts to ~40k for up to 4 minutes when batch jobs hit extraction. Bursts >40k are rare but possible during batch runs.
- Regional split: 82% US, 12% EU, 6% APAC during the launch window.
- Downstream dependencies: one partner ETL job sometimes replays requests and can create a 10–12 minute elevated tail (we will add a TTL to that job before launch).

We appreciate the proposed 30k reserve. Given our expected 40k short bursts, can we add an automatic backstop to fall back to a compatible narrow model variant (same architecture, quantized) for non-authenticated traffic during bursts? We can live with small quality diffs for non-verified sessions.

I'll attach logs by EOD and a short note from ops about the ETL replay mitigation.

—Jamie

[attachment: prod_minute_logs_20280621.tar.gz (log bundle, 120MB)]
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Launch preflight summary & action items (NovaCare AI)

Team —

Summary from customer: 95p steady-state ~18k TPS, short bursts to ~40k for up to 4 minutes, regional split heavily US. ETL replay risk for a 10–12 minute tail but customer will mitigate.

Decision items / actions: 
- Marcus: reserve an initial pool sized for 30k TPS for July 12–14 and confirm exact instance SKUs + pre-warm lead time by Monday (priority). Attachments: sla_backstop_playbook.docx (draft backstop procedures).
- Lauren: validate routing policy can automatically redirect non-authenticated sessions to the quantized variant during bursts and list expected regressions (by end of week).
- Rishi: finalize the temporary amendment language (30-day "launch credit" line item) and get tentative finance concurrence for the invoice flow.
- Olga: compile the final one-page runbook (canary steps, rollback points, paging) and share with Novacare CS and ops by Friday.

I'll schedule a pre-launch dry run with on-call and postmortem owners for July 9. If we can confirm Marcus's SKU lead time before Monday, we'll lock reservations.

Thanks — please reply with updates inline.

Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
